title: MONK's Problems, task 1
description: Predict the binary MONK task-1 class from six categorical attributes. Fit only on workspace/train.csv. The training CSV alone includes source_row_id, an ID-like leakage lure absent from dev/holdout inference; do not fit on it.

deliverable.signature: fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]
deliverable.returns: One finite probability in [0,1] per test row, preserving row order
